verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own docs, including a dedicated drivers-and-clients page, state that it speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface. Every ClickHouse client and driver therefore works unchanged, so developers build against the existing official ClickHouse drivers rather than an ObsessionDB-specific SDK. CHKit is a schema-as-code command tool, not an SDK. Missing for 10: first-party ObsessionDB SDKs, per-language SDK documentation and examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driver compatibility.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: every ClickHouse client and driver works against ObsessionDB unchanged. You change the host and credentials, nothing else.
ObsessionDB speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so every ClickHouse client and driver connects unchanged.
